claim_audits.claim_text: Nikhil Mittal is Zepto’s current Chief Technology Officer and leads its engineering and technology organization.
claim_audits.reasoning: The source explicitly identifies Nikhil Mittal as Zepto's CTO and describes him as building the infrastructure and working with the team, which supports his leadership of the company's engineering and technology organization.

evidence_chunks.text:
Nikhil Mittal
I'm the CTO at 
Zepto
. We're organising retail in India - building the infrastructure that lets people get groceries delivered in minutes. We've grown from a small experiment into one of India's fastest-growing companies, with a team obsessed with execution and speed. I joined Zepto's founders, Aadit and KV, early - before Zepto, we ran KiranaKart together, couldn't find the right product-market fit, shut it down, and started over. That's how the best things get built. Before that, I was building iview.ai - using generative AI and video to fix hiring. I was early and bullish on generative AI; I still am. Before that, I was at Goldman Sachs, working on consumer products including the Apple Card. I studied Computer Science at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. Right now I'm deep in agentic AI - running experiments, figuring out where the real value is. I also back founders I believe in, or problems I can't stop thinking about. Outside of work, I'm happiest travelling somewhere new, around a table with good food and better company, or mid-game in a long session of cards or board games. 🇮🇳 🇺🇸 🇸🇬 🇮🇹 🇳🇴 🇪🇸 🇹🇭 🇱🇰 🇮🇩 🇶🇦
